style.vernacular: A hillside village of about fifty people on a volcanic slope above Bounty Bay: single-storey timber-framed or block bungalows with verandahs, painted white or pastel, under low gabled or hipped corrugated-iron roofs, each with a rainwater tank and roof solar panels, set in lawns with palms, banana and breadfruit, linked by narrow concrete tracks (quad bikes, no cars of note).
style.ornament: Carved miro-wood Bounty models and Pitcairn souvenirs, the Bounty anchor and Bible as relics in the Square, boat sheds with longboats at the landing, flagpoles, plain verandah posts with white balustrades; very little applied ornament.
